# Max Booster crawler rules — https://maxbooster.replit.app
# Public surfaces stay crawlable; authenticated/app surfaces are excluded.

User-agent: *
Allow: /
Allow: /marketplace
Allow: /storefront/
Allow: /share/

Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /ws/
Disallow: /auth/
Disallow: /login
Disallow: /register
Disallow: /dashboard
Disallow: /studio
Disallow: /settings
Disallow: /admin
Disallow: /billing

Crawl-delay: 10

# Major engines ignore Crawl-delay; give them the same path rules explicitly.
User-agent: Googlebot
Allow: /
Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /ws/
Disallow: /auth/
Disallow: /dashboard
Disallow: /studio
Disallow: /settings
Disallow: /admin
Disallow: /billing

Crawl-delay: 10
Allow: /
Disallow: /api/
Disallow: /ws/
Disallow: /auth/
Disallow: /dashboard
Disallow: /studio
Disallow: /settings
Disallow: /admin
